race.comment: QUIRKY PRINCESS (5) brings the strongest profile after a narrow BM66 second at Scone, where she travelled well and was beaten just under a length. Her previous third at Scone was sound, and the important point is that she is already proven at this distance and at Tamworth, with the winning rider back aboard. PATHELIA (8) is the danger off a long-neck second in BM58 grade at Orange, especially as she has placed at both the distance and this track, although her winless 29-start record stops her being a risk-free proposition. DUNDEE TALES (1) has the Coffs Harbour second to recommend him and was only beaten three and a half lengths in BM58 grade last time, but his 2100m record is more place than win. PEPPERINA (4) was checked late when well beaten in a BM58 at Scone and gets a kinder grade setup, though this is her first attempt around 2100m and she has to rebound sharply from two plain margins.
